follow-up time: Three follow-up periods (specific durations not mentioned)
exposure: Physical and mental quality of life
outcome: Functional status (measured by the Amharic version of WHODAS 2.0 instrument)
finding: Maternal functioning in the postpartum period is initially impaired but improves over time, with maternal morbidities associated with worse functioning scores.
mod_finding: Vaginal mode of delivery was associated with worse functional status scores.
